questions.question: Since when have scientists understood that a few gases keep the Earth warm?
options: Since around the time of the American Civil War.

questions.question: What is the online primer for?
options: To explain how scientists know what they know about climate change.

questions.question: Why are ice cores from Greenland and Antarctica so useful?
options: They trap tiny bubbles of ancient air.
They show the colour of the old oceans.
They are easy to melt and drink.

questions.question: How much higher is CO₂ in the atmosphere than 150 years ago?
How do scientists check that their temperature calculations are good?
options: Independent groups reach the same conclusions.
They use a single, very good thermometer.
